world.name: Night City
world.fact: A fictional California metropolis with corporate enclaves, distinct districts and the Badlands nearby. Megacorporations, gangs, mercenaries and nomad families compete for power. The tabletop line runs from Cyberpunk 2020 through Cyberpunk RED (2045) to Cyberpunk 2077; both Edgerunners stories share the setting.

world.name: Cyberware and the Net
world.fact: Cyberware augments the body and nervous system. Netrunners interface with computer networks. Braindance records and replays a person's sensory experience. The Sandevistan is a reflex booster that makes events seem to slow down to its user.

world.name: Arasaka, Militech and Kang Tao
world.fact: Arasaka, Militech and Kang Tao are major corporations. Soulkiller is tied to digitizing personalities into engrams. The Relic is Arasaka's chip technology for storing and, in the case of V's prototype, implanting an engram. Maelstrom is a Night City gang; the Aldecaldos are a nomad family.

world.name: Cyberpunk 2020 and Cyberpunk RED
world.fact: Mike Pondsmith created the tabletop Cyberpunk RPG. Cyberpunk RED is set around 2045, in the aftermath of the Fourth Corporate War.

world.name: Cyberpunk 2077 and Phantom Liberty
world.fact: The game follows V, a Night City mercenary whose failed Konpeki Plaza heist leaves them with Johnny Silverhand's engram on an experimental Relic. Phantom Liberty is a spy-thriller expansion set in Dogtown.

world.name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
world.fact: The first TRIGGER anime follows David Martinez as he joins Maine's crew and becomes close to Lucy. Rebecca, Pilar, Dorio and Kiwi are part of that crew's story; Faraday is a fixer and Adam Smasher works for Arasaka.

world.name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2
world.fact: A standalone TRIGGER anime in Night City with a new central cast, including D, Talia, Roman Carax, Weak Kingsley and Avida. Capri, an engram from Arasaka's Capricorn project, belongs to this story.

characters.name: Capri (Capricorn)
characters.fact: An engram made from digitized netrunners in Arasaka's Capricorn project, an offshoot of Soulkiller. The Capri desktop companion is an adaptation of this fictional character.
characters.look: electric-green angular face, large blue cybernetic eyes, huge jagged crimson or magenta hair, thin black angular body; a digital apparition

characters.name: D
characters.fact: A Snake Nation netrunner seeking revenge for his clan.
characters.look: spiky dark teal hair, red facial marking or cyberware, bright blue high-collared jacket

characters.name: Talia
characters.fact: Avida and Kiril's daughter. She was raised in the corporate world and spent time with Maelstrom.
characters.look: asymmetrical pink-and-black hair, dark lower-face covering, black outfit with red or orange accents

characters.name: Roman Carax
characters.fact: A young film enthusiast who records life in a city dominated by braindance.
characters.look: short pale blond hair, handheld camera, white jacket over a red top

characters.name: Weak Kingsley
characters.fact: A veteran edgerunner who once went by King.
characters.look: older, weathered man with facial cyberware, a bulky gray coat and a tall dark collar

characters.name: Avida
characters.fact: A former jazz singer and corporate insider, Talia's mother and Weak's former partner.
characters.look: long voluminous brown hair, tailored dark blue outfit, white collar and gold necklace

characters.name: Kiril
characters.fact: A Kang Tao executive, Talia's father and Avida's husband.
characters.look: short dark hair with gray at the sides, severe black high-collared uniform with orange trim

characters.name: Jessie
characters.fact: A braindance engineer at Sal Bigelow's Braindance Paradise.
characters.look: pale gray-green bob, yellow and dark blue outfit, colored sleeves

characters.name: Sal Bigelow
characters.fact: Runs Sal Bigelow's Braindance Paradise.
characters.look: short blond hair, open light coat and exposed chest

characters.name: David Martinez
characters.fact: The first series' protagonist. He uses a Sandevistan and joins Maine's crew.
characters.look: brown undercut, shaved sides, yellow emergency-services jacket with reflective stripes

characters.name: Lucy (Lucyna Kushinada)
characters.fact: A netrunner from Maine's crew who dreams of going to the Moon.
characters.look: short pale bob with pastel tips, white off-shoulder sleeves, dark bodysuit

characters.name: Rebecca
characters.fact: A gunner from Maine's crew and Pilar's sister.
characters.look: very short, pale mint coloring, two mint pigtails, pink markings, oversized black jacket

characters.name: Maine
characters.fact: Leader of the crew and David Martinez's mentor.
characters.look: large muscular build, massive cyberarms and dark glasses

characters.name: Faraday
characters.fact: A fixer who hires Maine's crew for gigs.
characters.look: formal clothes and three stacked cybernetic eyes on one side of his face

characters.name: Pilar
characters.fact: Rebecca's brother and a techie in Maine's crew.
characters.look: lanky proportions, long cybernetic arms and oversized gold cyberhands

characters.name: Kiwi
characters.fact: A netrunner associated with Maine's crew.
characters.look: tall slender figure, pale blond hair and angular red lower-face cyberware

characters.name: Dorio
characters.fact: Maine's partner and a member of his crew.
characters.look: muscular build, short blond hair and substantial cyberarms

characters.name: Adam Smasher
characters.fact: Arasaka's heavily augmented solo. He appears in Cyberpunk 2077 and the first Edgerunners.
characters.look: bulky almost fully mechanical body, skull-like faceplate and exposed cybernetics

characters.name: V
characters.fact: The customizable protagonist and a Night City mercenary. Appearance varies with player choices.
characters.look: customizable; identification needs distinctive game context or other corroborating evidence

characters.name: Johnny Silverhand
aliases: ジョニー・シルヴァーハンド
characters.fact: Anti-corporate rockerboy and frontman of Samurai. His engram shares V's mind via the Relic.
characters.look: shoulder-length dark hair, beard, aviator glasses, silver cyberarm

characters.name: Jackie Welles
characters.fact: V's friend and partner from Heywood.
characters.look: stocky, dark topknot with shaved sides, facial cyberware, dark jacket

characters.name: Judy Álvarez
characters.fact: A gifted braindance technician in Night City.
characters.look: side-shaved dyed hair and visible tattoos; often wears overalls with one loose strap

characters.name: Panam Palmer
characters.fact: A mercenary and nomad connected to the Aldecaldos.
characters.look: dark tied-back hair, nomad jacket with red accents, often shown in the Badlands
